title: protocol.json.method
description: Which method manifest (methods/*.json) governs this review, recorded once at protocol time. Read by tools/method.py. Absence of this whole block (a legacy protocol.json predating this schema) means "systematic_review", recorded=false -- see docs/PLAN.md M1's migration path, not an error.

id.description: Must match a methods/<id>.json manifest's own "id" field -- tools/method.py checks this at resolve time, not this schema (the set of shipped methods changes across milestones).

recorded.description: True when a reviewer (or /prisma-init's routing, from docs/PLAN.md M2 onward) actually chose this method before the first protocol-driven run. tools/method.py sets this false only for its own defaulted resolution when the block is absent entirely -- never hand-set false in a real protocol.json.
